title: Proportionate involvement gives clear support
meaning: Combining different needs for proportion is emotionally answered by clear boundaries and a sense of common support.
text: Different participation can have a clear and proportionate form. Temperance in the physical position of this Energy Field describes shared actions where you combine different needs and ways of participating. Justice in energy motivates attention to contributions, restrictions and consequences for each person. The Emperor in emotions adds support from an understandable arrangement and defined boundaries. The overall tone can be organised: you practically accommodate differences for a proportionate decision and emotionally value each person having a recognisable place within the shared agreement.

For example, you divide use of one small workshop. One person works for long periods infrequently, while the other needs short, frequent sessions. Combining the rhythms, you consider actual time and expenses before marking clear hours. **Our different participation has acquired a form we can rely on.** Calm concerns the definition of a particular agreement; it does not establish that convenience will remain forever under every change in capacity. The arrangement serves a present situation rather than settling all possible future ones.

A difficulty arises if the feeling of support makes the original calculation untouchable. One person now uses the space differently, but a revised proportion seems to threaten order. The motive of fairness gives way to defending a scheme. Justice guarantees no infallible formula, and the Emperor in emotions makes no boundaries final. Temperance in action allows participation to be reconsidered, including differences in how much definition each person currently needs for a comfortable shared activity.
